aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab creates practical software for food trucks and mobile catering: online ordering, pickup times and fewer repeated questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We create practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering: we help them take online orders, manage pickup times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools that fit the way these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory that helps people find food trucks coming to their area, I learned more closely about the difficulties mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly on the move, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see pickup times your kitchen can really manage. The system works from each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at the same time.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system prevent my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Stripe’s fees also apply to online card payments: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost for {country}?
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is} other {The first # months are}} free with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, with Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is charged monthly in advance and you keep access until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. Ask your tax adviser how to record online orders in your till.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose the dishes and the pickup time, pay online or when they pick up, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or POS terminal takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers place an order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you give a customer a buzzer, assign its number to the order so you know which device belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers see: order numbers and which ones are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates — such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety — in one place. We remind you before they expire, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads straight to its own ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, plus the only way to keep taking orders when the signal is lost.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combo menus and offer add-ons at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like the automatic replies on WhatsApp, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens — counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your staff separate accounts with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: When the signal is lost, online ordering pauses so customers do not place orders you will not see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline too; the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance via Stripe when customers order online.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a last ordering time for items that need advance preparation.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not appear on the map — they get their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Add what each dish costs you and see your real profit at every event, not just your takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a picture you already share on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as “sold out” with one tap — it immediately appears grey for customers.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count: it goes down as orders come in, then the item automatically becomes “sold out”.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone — no separate card terminal needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a time slot for the pickup time, and the load is spread across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck; payment is taken on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from any phone, tablet or laptop browser.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Reply automatically to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the POS terminal you already take payment on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable Wi-Fi and the same opening hours every week. But you work somewhere new every week, at different hours, with weak or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was created exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: When the signal is lost, online ordering pauses automatically so customers do not place orders you will not see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.

landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order in advance and choose a pickup time. Queues get shorter, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Created for food trucks, not for restaurants.
